gta: Someone asked this website to turn a block into GTA six.
That's the ask, from a stranger, on a Sunday.
It built it. In the browser. It cost six cents.
Every change is a real pull request, with the price on it.
loop: This website does whatever you ask it to.
Point at anything. Say what should change.
A judge reads it. If it's good for everyone, an agent builds it.
Two minutes later, it's live. For everyone. As a real pull request, with the cost in cents.
It's called everyone's dot lol. Go change it.
timelapse: Every change anyone ever made to this website, in ten seconds.
Nobody made this. Everybody made this.
rules: Anyone can change it. So why isn't it a mess?
Ten rules, written down, that anyone can read.
No ads. No links out. Nothing hidden. Keep it working on a phone.
Ask it to plug your startup and it says no, and tells you why.
Big asks go to a vote. Every three hours, the most wanted one gets built.
There is no human in the loop. There's a rulebook, a judge, and a sandbox.
phone: It works on your phone too.
It's a world of tiles. Swipe to walk.
Hold an object to see who made it, or to move it.
Tap change, tap anything, say what should be different.
